title: American Ninja 4: The Annihilation
description: Michael Dudikoff is back in action in this thrilling sequel! Teamed up with CIA operative Sean Davidson (David Bradley), Joe Armstrong (Dudikoff) returns to help foil the plans of a terrorist (James Booth) hell-bent on annihilating New York City.

title: Double Impact
description: Jean-Claude Van Damme leaps into dual roles of Chad and Alex Wagner, twin brothers separated after their parents’ brutal murder. Twenty-five years later, fate reunites them and ignites their determination to exact revenge... with two times the pain.

title: Bloodsport
description: In the role that kicked his international career into high gear, Jean-Claude Van Damme stars as Frank Dux, a man who refuses to lose and who might just win himself a place in history as he competes in a full-contact world championship competition.

title: RoboCop (2014)
description: In 2028 Detroit, when Alex Murphy (Joel Kinnaman) -- a loving husband, father and good cop -- is critically injured in the line of duty, the multinational conglomerate OmniCorp sees their chance for a part-man, part-robot police officer.

title: Hercules (2014)
description: Dwayne Johnson stars as the most towering myth of all time, revealing the man behind the legend in this bold reimaging of the famed Hercules!

title: Walking Tall (2004)
description: When it comes to laying down the law, one man can make a difference! Action superstar Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson takes no prisoners as he fights for justice and crushes corruption in this story of one man who takes a stand and takes back his town!

title: Walking Tall: The Payback
description: In this action-packed sequel, Kevin Sorbo discovers the quiet town he grew up in is now overrun by a violent gang. And it's up to him to take it back!

title: Firewalker
description: Two hapless soldiers of misfortune (Chuck Norris, Louis Gossett Jr.) meet a beautiful girl (Melody Anderson) with a map to a lost gold mine and decide to have one last shot at striking it rich. But the trail to the treasure is no yellow brick road!

title: Breaker! Breaker!
description: Breaker! Breaker! stars Chuck Norris at his butt-kicking best as a trucker on a mission to locate his kidnapped brother and bring down a corrupt Judge (George Murdock) who may just have played a role in the disappearance.

title: The Octagon
description: Chuck Norris is back in this action-packed martial arts showcase co-starring the legendary Lee Van Cleef. Norris takes on his adoptive brother and a training camp where terrorists are being taught the secret killing techniques of the ninja!

title: Enter The Ninja
description: When Cole (Franco Nero), a westerner trained in the deadly fighting rituals of Ninjitsu, is suddenly dragged into a dangerous dispute with an oil baron, he must face the best assassin money can buy, Ninja Hasegawa (martial arts legend Sho Kosugi)!

title: Revenge Of The Ninja
description: When a band of Ninja assassins slaughters the family of Cho Osaki (Sho Kosugi), he flees to America in the hope of building a new life. Osaki tries to escape his deadly past but soon discovers he has become the pawn of a ruthless drug trafficker.

title: Ninja III: The Domination
description: Possessed by the spirit of a diabolical Ninja assassin and dominated by his relentless rage, a young, attractive woman sets out to brutally attack and destroy his enemies. Can her boyfriend and a martial arts master possibly save her soul?

title: Anti-Trust
description: In this sizzling, fast-paced thriller, computer whiz Milo Hoffman (Ryan Phillippe) lands his dream job at a major computer company, only to learn that the C.E.O. (Tim Robbins) may employ some very unorthodox -- and very deadly --business practices.

title: Into the Blue
description: Paul Walker and Jessica Alba heat up the screen as two divers who dream of finding hidden treasure.

title: Bandits
description: Strap yourself in for one hilarious action-comedy starring Bruce Willis, Billy Bob Thornton and Cate Blanchett! Convicts Joe (Willis) and Terry (Thornton) run an ingenious bank robbery scheme...until they meet an eccentric housewife (Blanchett).

title: Ronin
description: Robert De Niro, Jean Reno and Stellan Skarsgard headline a stellar cast in director John Frankenheimer's action-packed and intelligent spy thriller about a group of for-hire mercenaries out to steal a top-secret briefcase for a mysterious client.

title: Thief
description: Michael Mann ("Manhunter") directs this stylish, action-packed drama that stars James Caan ("Misery") as a master safe cracker who is planning his last heist for the sake of a woman, Tuesday Weld ("Who'll Stop The Rain?"), and a new life.

title: To Live And Die In L.A.
description: Federal agent Richard Chance has a score to settle, and he's through playing by the rules. He vows to take down a murderous counterfeiter by any means necessary.

title: Kalifornia
description: A couple (David Duchovny, Michelle Forbes) sets out on a cross-country trip to research a book about serial killers and, along the way, pick up an ex-con and his girlfriend  (Brad Pitt, Juliette Lewis) who take them on a ride they'll never forget.

title: 10 To Midnight
description: Charles Bronson is Leo Kessler, a cynical cop on the trail of Warren Stacy (Gene Davis), a homicidal maniac. When the legal system sets Stacy free, Kessler has one option: to hunt down Stacy on his own before the crazed killer can strike again!

title: Assassination
description: Hard-hitting action, cross-country adventure and a government conspiracy that goes all the way to the top highlight this pulse-pounding political thriller in which Charles Bronson must protect the First Lady (Jill Ireland) from ruthless assassins.

title: Rage Of Honor
description: When his partner is killed during a drug bust, a federal agent throws away his badge and the rule book with it. Arming himself with an array of deadly weaponry including nunchucks and ninja stars, he sets out to settle the score with the bad guys.

title: Pray For Death
description: A vicious gang forces Akira to shed his quiet persona and reveal his other identity...that of a skilled Ninja!

title: Warriors Of Virtue
description: A disabled teen enters a magical realm where warrior-kangaroos battle evil, finding his true strength in this action-packed fantasy.

title: Bulletproof Monk
description: Chow Yun Fat and Seann William Scott star in this heart-pumping action-adventure when a mysterious Tibetan monk, who has protected a powerful scroll for 60 years, believes he has found his successor in a pick-pocketing, streetwise punk.

title: Hackers
description: Boot up for suspense and high-powered excitement with Jonny Lee Miller and Angelina Jolie when a group of hackers, the rebels of the information age, find themselves embroiled in a plot that could destroy the world's ecosystems…or their own lives.

title: Futureworld
description: After the "Westworld" disaster, the Delos corporation is back, this time with "Futureworld!" But the resort might not be as safe as Delos claims….

title: The Wild Angels
description: When a biker gang cyclist is injured and hospitalized, he is kidnapped from the hospital but dies. A funeral is staged in the local church with a drunken, drugged-out orgy.

title: The Glory Stompers
description: When the leader of the Glory Stompers is brutally attacked by a psychotic rival biker gang that kidnaps his girl and leaves him for dead, he gathers a few buddies and sets out to settle the score! Starring Dennis Hopper, Jody McCrea and Casey Kasem.

title: Harley Davidson And The Marlboro Man
description: Mickey Rourke and Don Johnson star in this four-lane genre collision of biker movie, heist thriller, buddy flick and sci-fi pic that will take you to the hardline of action and adventure! Co-starring Tom Sizemore, Chelsea Field and Vanessa Williams.

title: Bloodsport
description: In the role that kicked his international career into high gear, Jean-Claude Van Damme stars as Frank Dux, a man who refuses to lose and who might just win himself a place in history as he competes in a full-contact world championship competition.

title: Cyborg
description: Jean-Claude Van Damme stars in this adrenaline-charged sci-fi thriller as Gibson Rickenbacker, the future's most fearsome warrior. In the wake of a plague, Rickenbacker must rescue the only person who can develop a vaccine and save civilization.

title: Death Warrant
description: Superstar Jean-Claude Van Damme is Louis Burke, an undercover detective who is investigating a series of murders at a penitentiary. But when he unearths a shocking secret, he must attempt a daring escape that pits him against an enemy from his past!

title: Double Impact
description: Jean-Claude Van Damme leaps into dual roles of Chad and Alex Wagner, twin brothers separated after their parents’ brutal murder. Twenty-five years later, fate reunites them and ignites their determination to exact revenge... with two times the pain.

title: Hart's War
description: Bruce Willis stars as an imprisoned officer who refuses to give up his fight against the Nazis, even from behind enemy lines. With the help of a young lieutenant (Colin Farrell), he risks everything to free his men and change the outcome of the war!

title: The Devil's Brigade
description: They were misfits... and heroes! William Holden stars as Lt. Col. Robert T. Frederick who takes on the daunting task of melding a renegade group of American and Canadian recruits into a crack team of commando warriors in this riveting WWII saga.

title: Force 10 From Navarone
description: From director Guy Hamilton comes this action-packed WWII adventure! Screen legends Robert Shaw and Harrison Ford star as fearless commandos on a deadly mission to strike a crippling blow against Hitler's army during the darkest days of World War II.

title: The Train
description: Screen greats Burt Lancaster, Paul Scofield and Jeanne Moreau star in this suspense-laden tale of justice and retribution as a French Resistance fighter (Lancaster) attempts to stop a Nazi commander from looting the art treasures of Paris.

title: Run Silent, Run Deep
description: The legendary Clark Gable and Burt Lancaster star in this gripping, classic military drama aboard a submarine.

title: Pork Chop Hill
description: As the Korean War rages, Lieutenant Joe Clemons (Gregory Peck) finds himself standing at a crossroad.

title: The Manchurian Candidate
description: An Army Major discovers a devious plot by a cabal of enemy leaders bent on political upheaval.

title: No Way Out
description: Kevin Costner and Gene Hackman star in this taut, political thriller that sees Costner, as Naval Commander Tom Farrell, on the hunt for a very real killer and a very unreal Russian mole, and all the clues lead back to himself. Sean Young co-stars.
